prompt: Night on a British high street, camera low at pavement height looking along a row of shuttered shops. In the deep recessed doorway of a closed bank, a person lies asleep on flattened cardboard in a worn sleeping bag, hood up, face to the wall, shoes tucked beside them, a carrier bag of belongings as a pillow. A second sleeper further down the row in the next doorway. Wet paving catching orange sodium streetlight, a cold greenish cast in the shadows, light drizzle. Quiet, still, treated with care and dignity. Ultra-wide lens close to the ground, deep focus, documentary realism, fine digital grain. Tall portrait frame.
